game.name: Rayman Origins (Europe)
game.desc: Rayman Origins is a platform game for Xbox 360. The title offers old-school gameplay in two dimensions and returns to the roots of the series. Through nearly 60 levels, the player must free small creatures called Electoons and collect Lums while being wary of the traps and numerous enemies that await him. Rayman Origins is also playable in 4 player co-op.
